predict.question: You knock on every door in a made-up neighborhood: five residents say yes and five say no. What share of the whole neighborhood says yes?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases; keep each result for the reveal.
bookIdea: How Minds Change examines how conversations and social contexts relate to changes in belief.
modelBoundary: The selected sample is {A}% yes; the population {B}%. Changing who is included changes the apparent consensus.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? No one changes a belief here; sampling arithmetic cannot establish a persuasion method.
